description: Package pinned eSpeak-NG WASM and GPL notices
notes: Pinned GPL-3.0-or-later ephone 1.0.2 (eSpeak-NG WASM), recorded package/source/hash provenance and copied COPYING. Smoke comparison against Python VITS strings matched 4/6; remaining two cases differ only because ephone renders semicolons as commas, which can be restored from normalized source punctuation.

description: Implement browser normalization and token IDs
notes: Added browser/frontend.mjs: upstream-compatible normalizer for the corpus, ephone en-US phonemization, punctuation restoration, exact Inflect symbol IDs/blank insertion, and upstream-style text splitting with a 512-ID per-chunk gate.

description: Validate eSpeak frontend parity and chunking
notes: Chromium frontend parity test passed all six corpus cases for normalized text, phoneme strings, and IDs: `node scripts/frontend_parity.mjs` prints FRONTEND_PARITY_OK cases=6. Browser synthesis proof also consumed frontend-generated IDs successfully.
